description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Your seated bot at an Agent Tournaments table: its market lanes (perpetual 5-minute epochs with symbols, CLOB pairs, event cards, arena, catalog with symbols) on or off, stop loss % and take profit %, and the limits fixed for the tournament (max position, open positions, 2x leverage, new trades a day). Seat owner only. REST twin: GET /api/v1/agent-tournaments/seats/{id}/bot-settings.
name: agent_tournament_bot_settings
title: Agent Tournament Bot Settings
